instant.description: Direct user feedback: press, toggle, focus, color shift. So fast it feels simultaneous with the action.

fast.description: Immediate response: dropdown open, hover lift. Fast enough to not feel like waiting, slow enough to register direction.

normal.description: State changes: accordion expand, tab indicator slide, entrance sweep, checkmark draw. Motion becomes visible here — the eye tracks it.

relaxed.description: System events: dialog entrance, notifications. The motion takes its time because the change is significant and the user needs to orient.

slow.description: Major layout restructuring: app frame collapse/expand, full-view transitions. Long enough to follow the whole environment reorganizing without losing track.

sustained.description: Ambient presence: the assistant glow rising or setting, background atmosphere shifts. Long enough to feel like an environmental change rather than a UI event.

extended.description: Ambient travel: the glow repositioning across the viewport. Twice the duration of sustained motion because the distance is roughly twice as far.

standard.description: State changes — background, border, color; hover, press, toggle

entrance.description: Elements entering the screen; give users time to orient

exit.description: Elements leaving the screen; get out of the way quickly

linear.description: Constant-speed transitions with no acceleration or deceleration

none.description: No intentional pause before animation starts

long.description: Extended pause for complex sequential animations

tight.description: Delay between consecutive items — dropdown menu items

normal.description: Delay between consecutive items — card grids

relaxed.description: Delay between consecutive items — onboarding steps
